tokens.name: surface-window
tokens.usage: Step 0: window, page, title bar and the gutter around the sidebar panel.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Step 1: cards, fields, docked panes and commit footers.

tokens.name: surface-well
tokens.usage: Fields and lists inside a floating surface (the delete dialog's title list and input).

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Step 2: raised controls (default buttons).

tokens.name: surface-active
tokens.usage: Step 3: hover, the selected segment, the active nav item, neutral tags and badges.

tokens.name: surface-pressed
tokens.usage: A control while it is pressed.

tokens.name: surface-floating
tokens.usage: Everything that floats: sidebar panel, menus, selection bar, tooltips, toasts, dialogs. The lightest surface in the light theme.

tokens.name: surface-floating-hover
tokens.usage: Hover of an item on a floating surface (menu items, sidebar nav).

tokens.name: line-row
tokens.usage: Row hairline between table and list rows.

tokens.name: line-section
tokens.usage: Section divider under headers and between docked panes. Starts at the content inset.

tokens.name: line-edge
tokens.usage: 1px edge of controls (buttons, fields, chips) and of every floating surface.

tokens.name: line-kbd
tokens.usage: Edge of key caps.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text.

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: table cells, nav labels, ghost buttons, segments, tag text.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Counts, meta lines, section labels, table headers, placeholders. 4.5:1 on window, card and floating.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and icons, at full opacity (no opacity states).

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: The accent, only for the logo, the active page icon, progress, the primary button, the selection (checks, current-row mark) and a focused field's border.

tokens.name: gold-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Label and icons on a gold fill.

tokens.name: gold-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of an active chip and the sidebar count pills.

tokens.name: gold-tint-edge
tokens.usage: Edge of an active chip.

tokens.name: selected-row
tokens.usage: Selected table and list rows (the current row adds an inset 2px gold mark).

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Done: the check glyph and its word.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Not matched, uncertain, missing: the glyph and its word.

tokens.name: warn-bar
tokens.usage: Space bar of a drive that is nearly full.

tokens.name: warn-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of a warning tag.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Permanent deletes and failures only.

tokens.name: bar-neutral
tokens.usage: Space bars and neutral meters.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Track under every bar; the off fill of switches.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Under text over artwork, in both themes.

tokens.name: scrim-text
tokens.usage: Text on the scrim (light in both themes).

tokens.name: qr-ink
tokens.usage: The dark modules of a QR code: dark on light in both themes, so every phone reads it.

tokens.name: qr-paper
tokens.usage: The light ground and quiet zone of a QR code, in both themes.

tokens.name: badge-scrim
tokens.usage: Under the stage badge on a poster: dark in the dark theme, near white in the light one.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring (2px, 2px offset, :focus-visible only): the text colour.

tokens.name: shadow-floating
tokens.usage: The one floating shadow (with `--surface-floating` and a `--line-edge` border). Tailwind: `shadow-floating`.
